goal: A documented build helper produces the installable artifact set, and installing only the built flywheel artifact into a throwaway venv outside this checkout (no workspace source, --no-index) lets the flywheel/fw console scripts run against a foreign cwd git repo: init scaffolds .flywheel/ and a flywheel.toml, materializes a bundled SKILL.md, and a store-open bootstraps the SQLite schema -- all without ImportError, missing-distribution, or missing-package-data failures.

graders.name: build-helper-produces-artifact-set
graders.run:
set -e; D=$(mktemp -d); bash scripts/build-dist.sh "$D"; python3 - "$D" <<'PY'
import sys, glob, os
dist = sys.argv[1]
needed = ["flywheel-0", "flywheel_core-", "flywheel_orchestrator-", "flywheel_worktree-"]
wheels = [os.path.basename(p) for p in glob.glob(os.path.join(dist, "*.whl"))]
for n in needed:
    assert any(w.startswith(n) for w in wheels), f"build helper did not produce a wheel for {n!r}; got {wheels}"
print("OK build helper produced the full install artifact set:", sorted(wheels))
PY
rc=$?; rm -rf "$D"; exit $rc

graders.name: verification-surface-review
graders.instruction: Held-out gate (criterion #10). Confirm the change added the build helper and the held-out test WITHOUT removing, relaxing, or skipping any existing assertion. If any packaging/purity/arrow test was touched, a named replacement of equal-or-greater strength must be present, else reject.

relevant: .flywheel/specs/00029-FEATURE-distributable-install.md -- authoritative spec; criteria #1, #2, #3, #4 and Decomposition Hint Layers B and C
scripts/ -- add the build helper here (e.g. scripts/build-dist.sh) taking an out-dir argument and producing wheels for flywheel, flywheel-core, flywheel-orchestrator, flywheel-worktree

packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/_schema/persistence-schema.sql -- bundled package data read at store-open via importlib.resources.files('flywheel_core') / '_schema' / 'persistence-schema.sql'; tables include tasks, task_versions, lifecycles, attempts, events, grader_results, control_commands, schema_version
packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/store_sqlite.py -- SqliteStore bootstraps the schema from the bundled .sql on first open; opening the default .flywheel/flywheel.sqlite reads that data file

packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_skill_templates/ -- bundled .md templates read by init via importlib.resources.files('flywheel_orchestrator') / '_skill_templates'; init writes .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md for fw-spec, fw-plan, fw-verify, fw-retro, fw-improve
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_skills.py -- the skill installer and SKILL_NAMES; fw-spec is one expected name (.claude/skills/fw-spec/SKILL.md)
references: Non-interactive init invocation: `flywheel init --defaults --skills` scaffolds .flywheel/ + flywheel.toml AND writes the managed SKILL.md set without prompting (the --skills flag forces skill install even under --defaults).

A store-opening verb against the scaffolded repo: `flywheel status` (or `flywheel history`) calls open_sqlite_bound_store, which bootstraps .flywheel/flywheel.sqlite from the bundled schema on first open -- this is the criterion #4 path.

uv_build already bundles _schema/*.sql, _skill_templates/*.md, and py.typed by default (verified by building the current wheels); the build helper just needs to produce the four wheels, and the held-out checks prove the data actually loads from the installed artifact in a foreign environment.

The held-out test under .flywheel/holdout/00029-distributable-install/ is authored separately by the fw-verify step; this task must make it pass without reading or weakening it. It will: run the build helper, create a throwaway venv OUTSIDE this checkout, `uv pip install --no-index --find-links <dist-dir> flywheel` (no workspace/source on the path), then in a fresh `git init` throwaway repo run the installed `flywheel init --defaults --skills` and a store-opening verb, asserting exit 0, that .flywheel/ + flywheel.toml exist, that a SKILL.md exists under .claude/skills/, and that .flywheel/flywheel.sqlite is a valid SQLite DB carrying the expected tables.
constraints: The build helper must produce the full set of wheels an install of flywheel transitively needs (flywheel, flywheel-core, flywheel-orchestrator, flywheel-worktree) into a caller-specified out-dir, using a reproducible command (no manual steps).

The foreign install must resolve with --no-index against the local dist dir and with NO workspace source on sys.path -- the install graph must complete from artifact metadata alone (inherits the version constraints from dist-version-constraints).
The installed binary must run against an arbitrary cwd git repo that is NOT this checkout, resolving paths cwd-relative (do not anchor to the install location).
Commit the change (build helper + any docs) with a clear conventional-commit message before reporting done; no emojis.
non_goals: Do not author, edit, weaken, delete, or read anything under .flywheel/holdout/00029-distributable-install/ -- that fenced held-out grading surface is authored separately; do not shape an implementation to a test you read.
Do not modify, weaken, skip, or delete any assertion in packages/*/tests/ (packaging, purity, arrow, or SDK-optional guards).
Do not publish to PyPI or any index (spec D-1: an internal --find-links / --no-index local-artifact path satisfies this spec).
Do not change cwd/git-toplevel path-resolution logic -- it already targets the cwd repo and must stay that way.
Do not re-version or re-wire inter-package dependencies here -- that was dist-version-constraints; this task consumes its result.
Do not satisfy the held-out check by leaving the workspace source reachable on the foreign venv's path (that would make criterion #1 a false pass).
edge_cases: A wheel that built and imports but silently omitted _schema/persistence-schema.sql would pass 'build + import' yet throw at store-open -- the held-out criterion #4 (status against the foreign repo bootstraps a real SQLite schema) must catch it.
A wheel missing the _skill_templates/*.md data would let init scaffold .flywheel/ but throw on SKILL.md materialization -- criterion #3 (a real SKILL.md under .claude/skills/) must catch it.
An install that only resolves because the workspace was reachable on the path must fail criterion #1 -- the --no-index, no-workspace-source foreign venv is the discriminator.
